newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-EDBERG AMAZED AT SAMPRAS EFFORT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EDBERG AMAZED AT SAMPRAS EFFORT.

text.p: Stefan Edberg gave his farewell Grand Slam performance at the U.S. Open on Thursday, but took time afterwards to marvel at the effort of quarter-final surviver Pete Sampras.
"Incredible," Edberg said when asked about Sampras's performance in taking a fifth-set tiebreaker 9-7 to beat Spaniard Alex Corretja despite suffering from dehydration and upset stomach.
"That is the word for it. I think everybody was watching in the locker room."

Edberg was waiting to go on for his quarter-final night match against Goran Ivanisevic, which he lost in three sets. But the Sampras-Corretja day match extended into night in a torturous four-hour, nine-minute struggle.
"I have seen Pete in other matches and what he can do under those circumstances ... I don't think anybody can do it.
"It was just hard to believe what was going on there, and I don't know how he won the match, but it was a fantastic effort."
